operator-walkthrough.ref: WHAT THE OPERATOR SEES after this diff (nickstire/admin-prune-w1, job 2026-10-19-admin-prune, 2026-10-19), to be audited post-merge on nickstire.org/admin from the owner's iPhone PWA: (1) Sidebar and drawer: 20 sections become 13 plus main's owner-only Shop media. Daily: Today, Lot, Approvals, Customers, Sales Pipeline, Money, Tires. Reach: Website & Local, Instagram, Shop media, Outreach. Automation: Voice Receptionist. Truth: Reports. System: Settings / Safety. Gone from the sidebar: Opportunities, Call Tracking, Market, Traffic to Revenue, Marketing / Growth, Nonstop Nick, Intelligence HQ; the Ad Studio topbar button is gone. (2) Where each moved, as a tab: Sales Pipeline > Opportunities; Voice Receptionist > Calls; Reports > Search (was Market) and Reports > Traffic (was Traffic to Revenue), both owner/manager only; Website & Local > Local Growth, GBP Q&A, Photo Queue, Entity / Brand, Competitors (was Growth); Customers > Members (was Nonstop Nick; an accountant sees only this tab) and Customers > Call list (owner/manager; was Intelligence HQ's customer intelligence); Settings > health shows the LLM spend panel. (3) Old links still work: any old ?tab= value, alias or inner-tab value, the browser back button, an in-app jump, a command-search hit and the paths /admin/leads, /admin/leads/<id>, /admin/callbacks, /admin/quotes/new, /admin/ad-studio land on the new home with the right tab; a stale ?id= never opens a customer profile after leaving Customers; a link to a page the role cannot see shows 'That section is not available for your role' instead of a silent Today. (4) Removed (0 opens in 14 days of production logs, most with 0 rows ever): Customers Loyalty and Coupons, Today's Inspection capture panel and the Keep/Less buttons on queue rows, Money's QC review and Technicians, Website & Local's AI Ideas, Prompt Health and Review Replies, Reports' Message Previews, Traffic's GSC audit, Settings' Quick estimate, Tire search and ALG probe budget, the Ad Studio page. (5) Moved, not removed: the Default markup editor is now on the Tires page (two-tap Save, 0 to 300); Technician referrals and the Lead delivery log stay on Sales Pipeline. (6) Customers and Reports say 'Could not check your access.' with a Retry when the role read fails or the phone is offline. Not device-tested at merge time: the owner's own look on his phone is owed.
